verdict.rationale: Evidence describes Godot's scripting options as GDScript, C#, and GDExtension/C++ — all code-based languages — with no mention of a node-based visual scripting system comparable to Blueprints; one community comment even contrasts Godot unfavorably to Unreal's visual blueprints for beginners, implying no such tool is highlighted. No evidence of a visual, no-code gameplay-logic authoring tool for technical artists.
